about:
Dutch Craft Furniture operates a showroom in Berlin, Ohio, about 70 miles south of Cleveland. The company's headquarters are in nearby Millersburg. The founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. The business began as a retail outlet for furniture crafted by Ohio Amish woodworkers.

The retailer carries an extensive inventory of solid-wood furniture—dining sets, bedroom suites, office pieces, and custom built-in cabinetry—sourced from a network of Amish makers. Its 10,000-square-foot showroom displays a rotating selection of finishes and hardwoods, including walnut, maple, and quarter-sawn white oak. Customers can order custom dimensions, add drawers, or request wood samples before purchasing. The company also provides white-glove delivery and in-home setup throughout the lower 48 states, with no freight shipping.

Dutch Craft Furniture serves primarily residential buyers furnishing homes, as well as commercial clients outfitting offices and hospitality spaces. The product range spans dining rooms, bedrooms, home offices, living rooms, children's rooms, and entryways, plus custom projects such as kitchen cabinets, entertainment units, and home bars.

The company emphasizes direct collaboration with Amish craftsmen, allowing it to offer a wide variety of styles, stains, and paint colors while guiding customers through the selection process. Its differentiators include a large showroom for hands-on evaluation, a wood-sample program, and a delivery model that avoids freight carriers entirely.
